2366-3430-5702-8296.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3430-5702-8296.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

628-7211-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Brambleback Brute.
When Brambleback Brute dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat.

225-4772-6753-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature that has power 2 or greater

1987-5913-7907.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-5913-7907.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Pinnacle Monk.
When Pinnacle Monk enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-5913-7907.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1115-2446-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1115-2446-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Living Hive, triggering Breath of Fury and Living Hive.
Resolve the Living Hive trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

443-2921-2946-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
443-2921-2946-4871.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3197-6097-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-6097-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1183-5231-6972.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Pentavus.
When Pentavus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.
1183-5231-6972.notes: Each loop, you can use mana from the previous loop and remove a +1/+1 counter from Pentavus to make creature tokens.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3738-6798-6972.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sightless Ghoul
When Sightless Ghoul dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sightless Ghoul
When Sightless Ghoul dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Umbral Collar Zealot abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
3738-6798-6972.notes: If Sightless Ghoul starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

3259-6965-7603.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that has base power 0.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6965-7603.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Primo.
Resolve the Primo trigger, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the damage dealt.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Fractal token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2558-5226-7422--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2558-5226-7422--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
Garrison Excavator triggers. Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a 2/2 creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

1902-7282-7340.notablePrerequisites: There are at least five Elves on the battlefield.
1902-7282-7340.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Sewer-veillance Cam.
When the Sewer-veillance Cam token enters, it triggers, untapping Wirewood Channeler.
Repeat.

321-399-2475-3497-6707.description:
Cast Metallic Sliver by paying {0}.
When Metallic Sliver enters, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to target player or planeswalker and causing you to gain 2 life due to its ability and lifelink.
Activate Metallic Sliver by paying 2 life, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

1874-2034-3490-4017.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1874-2034-3490-4017.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

2506-4050-4484-6896.easyPrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
2506-4050-4484-6896.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} due to Green Goblin.
When Ebondeath enters, Molten Echoes triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ebondeath, adding {B}.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {B}.
Repeat.

339-677-3480-6797.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3200-5660-6010.description:
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
When Urza's Bauble enters, Builder's Talent's second ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Resolve the Builder's Talent trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Urza's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-6642-6791.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6642-6791.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, SOLDIER Military Program triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-6642-6791.notes: If you control a commander, you can choose both of SOLDIER Military Program's modes.

116-1486-1753-4875.notablePrerequisites: Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
116-1486-1753-4875.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.
116-1486-1753-4875.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

1987-2239-4276-5913.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-2239-4276-5913.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Ardent Elementalist and Pinnacle Monk
When Ardent Elementalist and Pinnacle Monk enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2239-4276-5913.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

679-4971-6191.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
679-4971-6191.description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lich's Mastery triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

640-2760-4279.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
There is at least one other creature on the battlefield.
640-2760-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Dross Harvester triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any other creature and causing you to draw a card.
If the creature who had the counter placed has 0 toughness, it dies as a state-based action.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat until your opponents do not control any more creatures, or until you draw your library.
If you have cards remaining in your library, you may repeat this combo any time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

2829-2867-4636-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 3/3 Robot artifact creature token.
When the Robot enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing the Robot.
When the Robot dies, Demon of Dark Schemes' second ability triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2034-3079-3613-4999.notablePrerequisites: You have discarded at least two cards this turn.
2034-3079-3613-4999.description:
Cast Hollow One either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying at most {1}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hollow One, adding {C}{C}.
If you cast Hollow One from your graveyard, Hollow One is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Dress Down removing Hollow One's cycling ability.
Repeat.

38-4316-5220.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Skirk Prospector on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying {R}.
Repeat.

1035-4475.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has at least forty life.
1035-4475.description:
Cast Blessed Wind by paying {7}{W}{W}, causing an opponent with at least forty life to lose life until their life total is equal to twenty.
At the beginning of your end step, Wound Reflection triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
The opponent targeted by Blessed Wind in step 1 loses the game due to having zero or less life.

3525-4152-5184.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Undercity Scrounger.
Undercity Scrounger does not have summoning sickness.
A creature has died this turn.
3525-4152-5184.description:
Activate Undercity Scrounger by tapping it, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Undercity Scrounger.
Repeat.

1657-2034-4535.description:
Sacrifice Murderous Redcap to Ashnod's Altar to add {C}{C}.
Murderous Redcap's persist triggers, returning it to the battlefield.
Murderous Redcap returns to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter which cancel out.
Murderous Redcap triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2816-3151.easyPrerequisites: Umbral Mantle attached to Elvish Archdruid.
2816-3151.notablePrerequisites: Elvish Archdruid does not have summoning sickness. You control at least three Elves.
2816-3151.description:
Activate Elvish Archdruid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Elvish Archdruid by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

3554-3617-4001.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Cast Razaketh's Rite by paying its mana cost, searching your library for Seasons Past and putting into your hand.
Cast Seasons Past by paying {4}{G}{G}, returning Razaketh's Rite and Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand and putting Seasons Past onto the bottom of your library.
Repeat.
